output.reason: The only evidence, [ev-9413f4b657a9], says just "Fixed an issue when using mirror policies with waypoints." It does not say which resource or field carries the mirror policy, what the issue was, or what triggers it. The proposed condition makes up VirtualService paths (spec.http[].mirror and spec.tcp[].mirror) that the evidence never names. It is also too broad, because it leaves out the waypoint part and would flag any VirtualService that mirrors traffic, even where no waypoint is used. The surrounding notes ([ev-a3e90b78f6fa], [ev-437e36865221]) don't fill these gaps, so a correct condition would need the linked PR or issue showing which mirror configuration is affected and how a waypoint is attached.
